_notes_ship_status: A flagship's hull, systems, crew and hold (docs/space-jobs-contract.md; game/sim/Space/ShipStatus.cs, AwayTeam.cs). hull.bands: from (the band holds hull >= from, highest first; crippled at 0), flight (× flight times), scan_reach (× long-range scan and site identify range), hazardous (false: no hazardous site work in this band), text (its effect for the card). hull.crippled: at 0 the ship drifts (no course), every active space job fails, and it recovers to recover_to over recover_seconds. systems: id (a ShipSystem in snake case), name, effect (scan × site scans, flight × flights; tractor = no sweeping or pick-ups; life_support = injured crew don't recover), text; down_seconds [min, max] when a hazard knocks one out. repairs: field (Engineering crew: per_10s percent every 10 s up to up_to, × the field_repair lever; none while crippled or below the Engineering floor), patch (a hull patch kit from the hold: hull percent after seconds, or fixes one knocked-out system at once), dock (at a station: back to 100% and every system fixed after the station's dock_seconds; a colony ship also docks at its colony's body). crew: injury_seconds an injured member is out, medical_seconds taken off per medical store aboard (at most medical_max count), injury_min_seconds the least it can be, half_crew_flight (× flights while fewer than half the starting crew are on duty), log (lines kept), ranks / roles (per division) / names: away-team member names, from the player's hash. default_ship: a flagship with no fit-out record (a sandbox ship): crew per division (fit_out divisions order), hold containers, focus; every flagship without a fit-out also gets default_patch_kits patch kits. hold: survivors_per_container (survivors take a container per this many, rounded up; they always come aboard, even into a full hold, and join the crew while it is below where it started). away_team: min / max people, max_share of the crew on duty, max_by_ship (a picked ship's cap), step_seconds a step runs before its first choice is taken, return_seconds the team takes to come back after the last step (+ the picked choices' seconds, at least 5), defense_loss (loss points per person off for each Defense member), medic_division (a member of it on the team turns medic_share of the losses into injuries), quarantine_seconds. tables (per site kind's away_table): base odds in percent per person (injury, loss) and find (a good find), unpowered (added to the base while a known derelict is dark), steps (title; choices: label, hint, injury / loss / find points, seconds, shift = points added to outcome weights, bring = what the step-3 choice brings back if the find roll succeeds: research true (the site's research), salvage id, or survivors [min, max] with chance percent that the reading is real), outcomes (rolled once when the team is back: id, weight, text, research true (the site's research into the bank), hull damage, system knocked out, injure (members injured), loss_mult (× each member's loss chance), find_mult (× the find chance), quarantine (the whole team out for quarantine_seconds)). Phase 2 adds the hollow table (a hollow asteroid's cavity: maps space_sites asteroid away_tables). Each member then rolls loss (a medic turns medic_share into injuries) and injury. All numbers are placeholders. Phase 4 adds probe_reply: the answer to an alien probe (maps space_sites alien_probe probe.reply_table), three steps on the same machinery with no one leaving the ship (no team, so no injury or loss; its outcomes may not damage, injure, quarantine, knock out or deflect); the outcome is the answer, and probe.good names the outcomes that count as understood.

steps.title: What we tell it about us

choices.label: Who we are
choices.hint: A picture of a person, the ship, Earth.

choices.label: Where we are
choices.hint: Our course and our home. Honest, maybe unwise.
